stats.name: Rounds finished
stats.description: Finish a round after making at least one guess. Wins, give-ups and abandoned rounds count.

stats.name: Puzzles solved
stats.description: Solve a puzzle in any mode or difficulty.

stats.name: Hard solo puzzles solved
stats.description: Solve Single Player puzzles on Hard difficulty. Other modes and difficulties do not count.

stats.name: Unaided Medium solo solves
stats.description: Solve Single Player puzzles on Medium difficulty without using the hint.

stats.name: Guesses in finished rounds
stats.description: Count every guess made in rounds you finish. This measures activity, not skill.
